text: My office has received complaints from constituents who are concerned with vehicles speeding along Exbury Road, a statutory 50 km/h zone. This roadway has a series of all-way stops as well as a sharp turn immediately north of Tavistock Road which makes the roadway better suited as a 40 km/h zone. This is also a continuation of the adjacent section of Exbury Road between Tavistock Road and Deevale Road, which is already a 40km/h zone.
North York Community Council: 1. Approved a speed limit reduction on Exbury Road, from Jane Street to Tavistock Road, from 50 km/h to 40 km/h.
